AbbreviationAsWordInName.fix: Treat abbreviations as words: no run of capitals, so parseUrl, HttpClient, userId, never parseURL, HTTPClient or userID.

ArrayTypeStyle.fix: Put the brackets on the type, as in int[] values and String[] names, never int values[].

AvoidEscapedUnicodeCharacters.fix: Write the real character in the UTF-8 source, for example é, instead of a \u escape; keep an escape only for a control character.

AvoidStarImport.fix: Import each class by name (import java.util.List;), never a wildcard like java.util.*.

CatchParameterName.fix: Name the catch parameter lowerCamelCase, one letter or two or more characters with a lowercase or digit second, such as e or ioException.

ClassTypeParameterName.fix: Name class type parameters with one capital letter and an optional digit (T, K2), or a capitalized name ending in T (RequestT).

ConstructorsDeclarationGrouping.fix: Declare all constructors of a class next to each other, with no methods or fields between them.

EmptyCatchBlock.fix: Handle the exception: return a failure value, log and recover, or rethrow with the cause; in tests use assertThrows.

FallThrough.fix: End each case with break, return or throw, or merge the labels as case A, B ->; use an arrow switch to rule out fall-through.

IllegalTokenText.fix: Use the escape sequences \n, \t, \r, \f, \", \' and \\ instead of a unicode or octal escape for those characters.

InterfaceTypeParameterName.fix: Name interface type parameters with one capital letter and an optional digit (T, K2), or a capitalized name ending in T (ResultT).

InvalidJavadocPosition.fix: Put a Javadoc comment directly before the class, method or field it documents; use // or /* */ for any other comment.

JavadocMethod.fix: Make the Javadoc match the signature: @param only for real parameter names, @throws only for declared exceptions, and @return only on non-void methods.

JavadocParagraph.fix:
Separate paragraphs with an empty Javadoc line and start each following one with

glued to its first word, as in

Text.

JavadocTagContinuationIndentation.fix: Indent every continuation line of a Javadoc block tag at least 4 spaces past the asterisk.

LambdaParameterName.fix: Name the lambda parameter lowerCamelCase, one letter or two or more characters with a lowercase or digit second, such as o or order.

LineLength.fix: Break the line at an operator or argument, or extract a long expression or string into a named local or constant.

LocalVariableName.fix: Name local variables lowerCamelCase, one letter or two or more characters with a lowercase or digit second: totalCents, not tC or total_cents.

MemberName.fix: Name fields lowerCamelCase with at least two characters and a lowercase or digit second: userId, not uId, x or user_id.

MethodName.fix: Name methods lowerCamelCase, like rejectsNegativeQuantity; @Test methods may join lowerCamelCase parts with underscores, like evaluate_rightSide_validCases.

MethodTypeParameterName.fix: Name method type parameters with one capital letter and an optional digit (T, K2), or a capitalized name ending in T (ResultT).

MissingJavadocMethod.fix: Add a Javadoc comment whose first sentence says what the method does, or leave a short method undocumented only if it is not public.

MissingJavadocType.fix: Add a Javadoc comment on the type whose first sentence says what it represents.

MissingSwitchDefault.fix: Add a default branch that throws IllegalStateException, or make the switch an exhaustive switch expression over a sealed interface or enum.

ModifierOrder.fix: Order modifiers as public protected private abstract default static sealed non-sealed final transient volatile synchronized native strictfp.

MultipleVariableDeclarations.fix: Declare one variable per statement: int a; then int b;, never int a, b;.

NeedBraces.fix: Put braces around the body of every if, else, for, while and do, even a single statement.

NoFinalizer.fix: Delete finalize(); release resources with try-with-resources on an AutoCloseable, or register a java.lang.ref.Cleaner.

NonEmptyAtclauseDescription.fix: Write a description after every Javadoc block tag, such as @param name the customer id, or remove the tag.

OneStatementPerLine.fix: Put each statement on its own line.

OneTopLevelClass.fix: Keep one top-level type per file; move the extra types to files of their own, or nest them inside the main type.

OuterTypeFilename.fix: Name the file after its top-level type, so class OrderService lives in OrderService.java.

OverloadMethodsDeclarationOrder.fix: Declare all overloads of a method name next to each other, with no other method between them.

PackageName.fix: Name packages in lowercase letters only, no underscores or uppercase; digits are allowed after the first letter of a later segment: com.example.orders2.

ParameterName.fix: Name parameters lowerCamelCase, one letter or two or more characters with a lowercase or digit second: unitPrice, not uP or unit_price.

PatternVariableName.fix: Name pattern variables lowerCamelCase, one letter or two or more characters with a lowercase or digit second, as in if (o instanceof Order order).

RecordComponentName.fix: Name record components lowerCamelCase, one letter or two or more characters with a lowercase or digit second: record Order(String customerId).

RecordTypeParameterName.fix: Name record type parameters with one capital letter and an optional digit (T, K2), or a capitalized name ending in T (ValueT).

RequireEmptyLineBeforeBlockTagGroup.fix: Put one empty Javadoc line (a bare asterisk) between the description and the first block tag such as @param.

SingleLineJavadoc.fix: Keep a one-line Javadoc free of block tags like @param; write it over several lines, or use inline tags such as {@link Order}.

SummaryJavadoc.fix: Start the Javadoc with a one-sentence summary ending in a period, and do not open with @return, This method returns or A {@code X} is a.

TypeName.fix: Name classes, interfaces, enums, records and annotations UpperCamelCase with no underscores: OrderService, HttpClient.

UpperEll.fix: Write long literals with an uppercase L, as in 100L, never 100l.

VariableDeclarationUsageDistance.fix: Declare the local right before its first use, at most three statements earlier, or move the statements in between above it.
